chunks: Whatever was in it from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah al-Barqi, from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author's father as a link in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: al-Barqi; a key transmitter named in the chain
key_terms.الْمَرْوَزِيِّ: al-Marwazi; the attributed transmitter from Marw
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial citation of the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission and preserving hadith attribution within Shia hadith scholarship.
